reverse-engineering-agent 1.0.0

- Initial release with comprehensive reverse engineering capabilities for digital products and platforms.
- Supports multi-layer front-end analysis, backend logic inference, and technology due diligence.
- Provides structured workflows and industry best practices for reliable, actionable analysis.
- Designed to assess SaaS, AI Agents, mobile apps, open-source projects, API services, and more.
- Outputs clearly rated, evidence-based reports, focusing on compliance and practical recommendations.
